title: Google folds Display Ads into AI-first Demand Gen platform
summary: Google is consolidating its traditional Display Ads (Google Display Network) into a new AI-powered Demand Gen platform, effectively ending the almost 20-year-old digital advertising model that relied on predictable targeting frameworks and static creative.
problem_solved: Modernizes outdated display advertising by replacing manual targeting and bidding with AI-driven optimization.
why_valuable: Offers marketers more intelligent, automated ad placement and targeting capabilities compared to the legacy GDN model.
